title: KCREA
short_description: Multisite website for creative services for multiple churches with custom solutions for Pastors, Events, Sermons, Donations using ACF.
problem: Multiple churches needed a centralized digital platform to manage creative services, events, sermons, and donations. Each church required its own identity while still being part of a unified system, which made content structure and scalability a major challenge.
solution: I built a WordPress multisite solution that allowed each church to operate independently while sharing a consistent foundation. Using Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) and custom post types, I created flexible structures for pastors, events, sermons, and donation workflows tailored to each church’s needs.
implementation: Set up a WordPress multisite architecture for scalability
Designed custom post types and ACF field groups for structured content
Implemented donation flows customized per church
Maintained unified branding with room for site-level customization
